newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Mobil sees refinery at full output next week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Mobil sees refinery at full output next week.

text.p: Mobil Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it expected to restore its 108,000 barrel per day (bpd) Melbourne refinery to full output by early next week.
"The second crude (distillation) unit is not back up yet but we anticipate that to be by early next week," a spokeswoman for Mobil told Reuters.
One of the refinery's two crude distillation units has been shut down since August 13 for repair. The refinery is currently operating at around 80 percent production.
The spokeswoman sahe she could not be more specific about when the 65,000 bpd crude distillation unit was due to come back on line. "The crude unit is on the way back up," she said.
Crude distillation is the first stage of the oil refining.
